title: Create project, ingest media, review, version, and approve
accessibility: Upload progress and failures are announced without stealing focus
Player, timeline, comments, and approval controls are keyboard operable
Timecoded annotations expose text alternatives and logical reading order
Automated critical and serious accessibility violations equal zero
securityInvariants: Project and asset identifiers cannot cross tenant boundaries
Proposal activation requires an accepted decision, exact package version, approval receipts, complete content hashes, a mapped signing key, and a receiver-only proof
Application and database activation gates default off independently; the general service key cannot read receiver secrets or manufacture receipts
Commercial totals and payment authority remain in CCO OS and are not copied into Co-VideoPro
Filenames and object keys cannot escape the configured storage root
Media type, size, quota, and malware policy are enforced before commit
Approval status and version identity are server-authoritative
persistence: Upload progress recovers after reload or reconnect
Comment, annotation, decision, version, and approval survive reload
Acknowledged mutations have durable activity and audit records
Proposal handoff receipts cannot be updated, deleted, or truncated
concurrency: Parallel chunks cannot corrupt or exceed the declared upload
Two version creators receive unique ordered version numbers
Duplicate proposal handoffs return one project; payload drift under the same key fails closed
degradedDependencies: Storage capacity exhaustion rejects before partial commit
Transcode failure preserves the original and a retryable state
Database loss during finalization rolls back or reconciles the object
Notification outage does not roll back an otherwise durable approval
rollback: Failed version creation leaves the previous version authoritative
Failed deploy can roll back without orphaning in-flight upload sessions
Object and database reconciliation has a documented compensating action
